proof.text: The result is the corresponding group of geometric shrinking and finite coproduct steps in the proof of Lemma 04HJ.

lean.statement: theorem finite_decomposition_input {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal f)] (x : X) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (pts : Fin n → Y), (∀ i, f.base (pts i) = x) ∧ (∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ X) (u : U), Etale g ∧ g.base u = x ∧ ∃ (m : Fin n → ℕ) (W : (pullback f g).Opens) (V : (Σ i : Fin n, Fin (m i)) → (pullback f g).Opens), IsClosed (W : Set ↥(pullback f g)) ∧ (∀ a, IsClosed (V a : Set ↥(pullback f g))) ∧ Pairwise (fun a b ↦ Disjoint (V a) (V b)) ∧ (∀ a, Disjoint W (V a)) ∧ W ⊔ iSup V = ⊤ ∧ (∀ a, IsClosedImmersion ((V a).ι ≫ pullback.snd f g) ∧ u ∈ Set.range (((V a).ι ≫ pullback.snd f g).base)) ∧ (∀ p : ↥(pullback f g), p ∈ W → (pullback.snd f g).base p = u → ∀ i, (pullback.fst f g).base p ≠ pts i))
